0 Where we are

Facts from the repo docs, not a concept yet.

  • Round destination (#1): core loop v0. Sign-in, onboarding, Home/Discover, request, accept, chat. Real local data, on TestFlight.
  • Five tabs (#19): Home, Search, Suki, My Projects, Profile.
  • Backend (#10): Supabase enosggckdxjiaqtxalhg is production; develop locally. Bundle ID club.kizuki.ios.
  • Out of v0: Made Together outcomes, Google sign-in, payments, appeals/admin tooling, events, Spotify/Letterboxd import, real user data.
  • Design source: Figma full walkthrough. Visual coverage is partial until Figma access is fixed.
